text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
So fast! Big sister, you're so cool♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...She really is incredible, isn't she?
Big sis is, I mean...

Verxina's running clearly demonstrated
her natural talent and high caliber.
She is undeniably a cut above the rest of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: "Well, she didn't even make it to Open class. But Verxina-chan... you're aiming much higher, aren't you?"

As mentioned during the talk about Verxina's mother,
each race in the Twinkle Series has a grade,
and the classification system is strict.

Open is the name of that class,
and high-grade races—
Graded stakes like GⅠ races—belong to it.
"However, those without real skill can't even reach the Open class, let alone enter graded stakes. Among them, only a tiny handful can break into the upper echelon."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――...Not even close to enough.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: More than the person I fought at the very end...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, that was suuuuper-duper amazing!
Just as expected of you♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cheval-chi!
Your eyes were sparkling too, weren't they?♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-It's not good enough, I told you...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, in the end...
Onee-san is... different from other people.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: She's strong, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right.
I am strong—stronger than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'll show you an even more "amazing" big sister...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Well, I'll head to the hotel first!
See you later~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Take care.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
There's something I'd like to talk to you about.

As for our future plan...
Aiming for the Tiara route is already decided.
The question is, what do we do before we get there...

"First, build a body suited to her abilities. In other words,
I thought about advising her to focus on training and steadily
grow stronger. However—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I want to enter graded races as much as possible.
And if I can aim for it, GⅠ races too...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Being tempered and growing stronger amidst the harshness
of graded-class competition...
I believe that's what I need right now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"By repeatedly putting it into practice at a high level,
you should be able to build strength alongside experience."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...If I continue growing at my current pace,
I will never catch up to her."

What she says isn't wrong in itself.
However... in her voice,
there is just a faint hint of impatience.

It sounds like a statement born from
being overly conscious of
"that lady"... Gentildonna.
choice_data_list: There's also the path of training and growing first.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes,
of course I've thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However,
if we do that, it'll just be the same as always...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I feel that a certain level of hardship is necessary to achieve dramatic growth.
choice_data_list: ...Let me think about it for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once we return to the academy,
let us discuss it again properly.

I understand Verxina's point of view.
However, as long as her body can't keep up with her abilities,
it's dangerous to keep running in exhausting graded races.
choice_data_list: (To persuade someone as determined as her...)

text_block_list.text:
To provide absolute proof, I have no choice but to present the numbers.
So I looked for a nearby library
and hurried to compile the materials—

—The next day.
Before returning to Tokyo...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Were you not able to sleep well last night?
You have dark circles under your eyes...
choice_data_list: More importantly, take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There are so many notes written here...
What's this?
choice_data_list: That's why I want to make training my main focus.
That's why I want to make training my main focus!

text_block_list.text:
All the data I could possibly gather
from past Umamusume's measurement records
and sports science research...

What these indicate is that by training patiently,
one can achieve explosive growth in later years.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It also includes the results of a comparison
against sustained short-term stimulation, I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "There are benefits to continually running in races. However, accumulated fatigue carries a high risk of hindering growth in the later stages of a career"...

From the very first time we faced off, until our final match race...
I was constantly shown the sheer heights of her ability.

However, it's not that the defeated Verxina
was inferior. They were battling at an exceptionally
high level. In other words—

The difference with Gentildonna lay in pure physicality...
Blessed with an exceptional build, she delivered an astounding run even before her debut.

"Then for Verxina as well, the first essential step
is to build a body capable of fully channeling
and unleashing her power—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You stayed up all night researching just so I could understand and be satisfied, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...After that,
I gave it some thought myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Talking with Vivlos and the others helped calm my nerves...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Maybe wanting to throw yourself into a harsh environment... is just because you lack confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—You're just getting impatient
and blindly trying to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Even if that made me stronger, I might just end up breaking right away, wouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That is why... rather than fixating on graded stakes,
we will first prioritize our training.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: With that in mind—we'll aim for the first leg of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho!

We'll build up race experience as needed along the way,
while shaping Verxina's body to bring out her full potential...
That was the plan we agreed upon.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Until then...
I will stop obsessing over her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
――Big Siiis!
Let's take a photo with the three of us~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
You're being too loud...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I promise.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To become the strongest version of myself,
who they and you believe in!
